newsitem.title: USA: Atlas Environmental files for chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Environmental files for chapter 11.

text.p: Atlas Environmental Inc said Thursday it and 11 of its subsidiaries had filed for protection under Chapter 11 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code.
It said the petitions were filed on January 14 with the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Broward, Fla.
It said it plans to reorganize its operations and continue to operate under court protection.
Chapter 11 petitions are filed to secure court approval to reorganize while a company works out arrangements to pay debts.
